canonicalization.rule: sha256 hex of the UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(request, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)
canonicalization.applies_to: the `request` object only (never the nonce or the envelope)
canonicalization.server: Oracle computes this hash itself and serves only hashes on its Oracle-owned allowlist; a client-sent hash is never trusted

wire.framing: after the Tailscale Serve PROXY v2 header (added by Serve, never by the client): ASCII `fit1 <n>\n`, then exactly n bytes (1..16384) of UTF-8 JSON

body.nonce: <32 lowercase hex, fresh per call (os.urandom(16).hex()); a nonce seen the same Chicago day is refused>

wire.caller: only the V7 runner's ephemeral tag:v7-runner tailnet node, over the existing 47341 endpoint
wire.reply: one JSON line < 4096 bytes, or the connection closes with no output (unauthenticated or malformed input)

reply_fields.status: OK | REFUSED | BUSY | TIMEOUT | TIMEOUT_ORPHAN | ERROR | MODEL_DRIFT | OVERSIZE
reply_fields.request_hash: server-computed; the caller must check it equals its own canonical hash
reply_fields.nonce: echoed; the caller must check it equals what it sent
reply_fields.judgment_raw: the model's raw text when status is OK, else null; pass to the unchanged judge.accept()
reply_fields.receipt: provider, model, transport, agent, run_ids, run_finished, started, ended, fallback, usage ('unavailable'), cost ('unavailable'), deadline_s
reply_fields.reason: on REFUSED: NOT_ALLOWLISTED | NONCE_REPLAYED | COUNTER_UNAVAILABLE | DAILY_LIMIT

wire.fail_closed: anything other than status OK with matching request_hash and nonce, or a judgment judge.accept() returns None for, is no Fit

budget: each OK, TIMEOUT or ERROR reply is one of the 20 model runs per Chicago day; REFUSED and BUSY run no model
